selected.reason_full: AMD's rotation score surged from 7 to 9 while PCS crossed up from 75.5 to 79.0, the strongest simultaneous rot/PCS acceleration among all non-open candidates. The 5-week streak delivers +17.3% 4-week outperformance vs SPY — second only to PLTR among high-PCS peers. Extension risk is low with no overextension flags, confirming organic multi-week accumulation. Konc_3d_state=distribution is acknowledged as intermediate caution, but konc_w_state=up and the rot_score acceleration support weekly-driven conviction. us_tech_ai at 55.5% portfolio concentration is noted as extreme; the rot=9 jump and confirmed flow signal justify this incremental addition despite theme overweight.
selected.comparative_edge: Selected over TNZ.TO (PCS=77.2, rot=6) because AMD's rot_score=9 vs 6 and positive 4w return of +17.3% vs TNZ.TO's negative -6.9%, with lower extension risk (low vs medium+spike_flag). TNZ.TO's recent 4-week underperformance suggests momentum rollover despite its longer streak.

Extension risk is low with no overextension flags and spike_flag=false, confirming organic multi-week accumulation without single-session concentration.
13-week outperformance of +8.5% vs SPY combined with accelerating 4-week return shows building rather than fading institutional commitment.

us_tech_ai theme already holds 55.5% portfolio weight across 7 positions; adding AMD increases single-theme concentration to extreme levels.
13-week outperformance of only +8.5% is modest compared to peers like VLE.TO at +48% and UCO at +61.8%, indicating shorter-term momentum leadership rather than deep multi-month conviction.
Dems=4 is well below 10, meaning daily flow data cannot independently support the entry — weekly metrics must lead conviction per framework guidance.
